title: Templates for Complex Components and Structures
objective: Recognise how complex templates depend on controlled geometry, references and verification.

sections.heading: 1. Complexity
sections.body: Complex components can require several dimensions, reference points and relationships to be represented accurately.

sections.heading: 2. Controlled geometry
sections.body: Template geometry must correspond with approved drawings and specifications.

sections.heading: 3. References
sections.body: Reference lines, points and identifiers help relate template information to the intended component.

sections.heading: 4. Verification
sections.body: Complex information should be checked against the controlled source before it is used.
